objects.name: Analytic 2263
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Windows host-based firewall rule modifications or network interface configuration changes on Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows servers that block ICS command-message traffic, coinciding with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) showing communication loss to field devices. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: WinEventLog:Security
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: EventCode=5157 or firewall rule changes blocking Industrial Control Systems (ICS) command message traffic
